title: Overflow of fixed-width increment
statement: For every bit string $w$, the fixed-width little-endian binary increment overflows exactly when every bit of $w$ is $1$, including the empty word as the all-ones word of length zero.
replaced: For every bit string $w$, the fixed-width little-endian binary increment of $w$ (its successor among the words of length $|w|$, or overflow when there is none) overflows if and only if $w = 1^{|w|}$, that is, $w$ consists only of ones.
